name: unit_commanders
title: Unit commander tenures (data/unit_commanders.csv)
description: Hand-maintained. One row per sourced tenure: one person, one unit, one role, one interval. Modelled on data/command_relations.csv. A claim that names a commander on date X is evidence that the person was in command on X; it is not, by itself, evidence that the person took command on X or left command on X (valid_from_basis claim_date). Tenure ids UC0001 onward are never reused or renumbered. Evidence claims are in data/unit_commander_claims.csv.

fields.name: tenure_id
fields.description: Stable id of the tenure, UC0001 onward. Never reused or renumbered.

fields.name: unit_id
fields.description: The unit this tenure is for. Must exist in data/units.csv.

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: The person (data/people.csv).

fields.name: role
fields.description: Kind of command (vocabulary commander_role).

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Rank as stated for this tenure (General der Infanterie, Lt.-Gen., Act. Capt.). Free text. Blank when the source gives no rank. Decorations and service suffixes may be kept with the rank (R.N., D.S.C.).

fields.name: rank_disputed
fields.description: true when sources disagree on the rank. Explain in note.

fields.name: valid_from
fields.description: First day the tenure is known to hold, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). With valid_from_basis claim_date it is only the first day a claim names the person in this role; the tenure may have begun earlier.

fields.name: valid_from_latest
fields.description: Latest possible start when the source gives a range (valid_from is then the earliest possible start). Blank otherwise.

fields.name: valid_from_time
fields.description: Optional hour of the start on valid_from, HH:MM 24-hour. Blank = hour not documented.

fields.name: valid_from_basis
fields.description: Where valid_from comes from (vocabulary relation_start_basis).

fields.name: valid_to
fields.description: Last day the tenure holds, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Blank = no end recorded (see valid_to_basis and end_unknown). A missing end never means indefinitely valid. When valid_to_earliest is set, valid_to is the latest possible end.

fields.name: valid_to_earliest
fields.description: Earliest possible end when the true end lies in a range (valid_to is the latest possible end). For an undated change, the last claim date that names the person. Blank otherwise.

fields.name: valid_to_time
fields.description: Optional hour of the end on valid_to, HH:MM 24-hour. Blank = hour not documented.

fields.name: valid_to_basis
fields.description: Where valid_to comes from (vocabulary relation_end_basis); open_at_last_claim when valid_to is blank.

fields.name: end_unknown
fields.description: true when no sourced end exists (valid_to is blank, or only an inferred window from the next commander). false when a source dates a relief, death, or handover.

fields.name: change_undated
fields.description: true when the change of commander happened somewhere between two dated observations and no source dates the change. Nothing is guessed inside that range.

fields.name: date_basis
fields.description: Where the evidence for the tenure dates comes from (vocabulary relationship_date_basis).

fields.name: status
fields.description: preferred, or alternate / disputed when the tenure is known only from competing claims of a conflict group.

fields.name: conflict_group_id
fields.description: Conflict group (the existing G### series) when status is alternate or disputed, and when two preferred tenures compete on a date. Blank when there is no conflict.

fields.name: reference_ids
fields.description: ';'-separated reference ids of data/references_meta.csv; at least one.

fields.name: note
fields.description: What the sources say, including same-day handovers and open disagreements.
